name: Seeed XIAO ePaper EE05 (2.13" BWRY)
description: Seeed XIAO ePaper Display Board EE05 (XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus) driving the 2.13 inch quadruple-colour BWRY panel on the 24-pin FPC (JD79676 controller, 122x250 visible). Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API and paints a raw 2-bpp BWRY buffer (8000 bytes) produced by the esp32_bin renderer. The controller stride is 128 columns with 6 hidden, so the server pads the frame rather than scaling it.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware; bring-up tracked in tesserae-device-firmware issue #29. Wire format is exactly 8000 bytes (128*250*2/8): 2-bpp packed, four pixels per byte, MSB pair = leftmost pixel, palette indices 0=black, 1=white, 2=yellow, 3=red, row-major at the controller's 128-column native stride, top-left origin. The glass shows 122 of the 128 columns; the server pastes the visible frame at col_offset 6 and pads the hidden columns white. The offset edge and colour order are provisional until the selftest photo run confirms them.
